articleTitle: Proceedings at first annual general meeting November 18th, 1909
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: The First Annual General Meeting of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers was held in the Lecture Theatre of the Transvaal University College, Johannesburg, on Thursday the 18th November, 1909, at 8.15 p.m., Mr. J. R. Bradley (chairman of the Provisional Committee) presiding. There were also present :- 35 Members : Messrs. J. N. Andrews, F. W. Bentley, W. C. Brown, E. A. Browning, E. Crowther, H. H. Dahll, A. Dammrich, W. Elsdon-Dew, E. Ehrenberg, R. H. Goula P. E. Gregson, J. L. Hill, R. C. Hickling, S. Hodgson, J. Hopkinson, C. W. Inggs, F. Knauer, R. Macgregor, J. E. Maudlen, L. H. Marthinusen, C. McCann, A. B. Nicholetts, A. J. D. Nunns, W. H. Perrow G. T. Plumb, F. H. Powell, S. P. Sather, P. Saunders, Dr. M. Schwabach, W. Sutton, J. H. A. Watson, G. A. Webb, W. H. Winnall, L. B. Woodworth. 22 Associate Membtrs : S. Blythe, E. D. Brunner, R. B. Canning, T. S. Collins, E. Dalton, R. B. Hine, G. W. Heugh, B. Isaacs, T. C. Jarvis, W. H. James, M. G. Jillings, J. J. Kinleyside, F. Lowe, G. W. Lowe, C. A. Mader, G. E. Mossop, E. V. Perrow, J. S. Ross, A. E Scott, G. H. Seldon, T. Shaw, H. E. Winnall. 32 Associates : K. W. Carr, H. Hodgson, and Fred. Rowland, F.C.I.S. (Secretary pro tern).
